meta.call: detect_basis_distortion(symbol, exchange, spot_price, futures_price, expiry_date, snapshot_time)

output.explanation: Basis distortion detected for RELIANCE futures (NSE), expiry 2024-12-26 (28 days to expiry). Spot: 3,020.00. Futures: 3,065.00. Actual basis: +45.00. Fair-value basis (cost-of-carry at 6.5% RFR, 28 DTE): +15.06. Deviation: +29.94 (0.991% of spot). Threshold: 0.50%. Interpretation: futures are trading at an ABNORMAL PREMIUM to spot (excess contango). Consistent with artificial buying pressure in futures to create bullish momentum signals. Caveats: (1) This model omits dividend yield — accuracy degrades for stocks with near-term ex-dividend dates. (2) The threshold (0.50%) is an unvalidated estimate — the actual threshold should be calibrated from historical basis distributions for each instrument separately.
